# Define the custom filter
def sync_do_sum(value, initial):
    return sum(value) + initial

# Create a Jinja2 environment

# Register the custom filter
env.filters['sync_do_sum'] = sync_do_sum

# Data
data = [{'price': 11}, {'price': 21}, {'price': 31}]

# Render the template with the filter
